project_summary: Custodial crypto wallet mobile app with multi-sig and travel rule compliance

components.name: Multi-sig wallet core
components.description: HSM-backed key management, 2-of-3 signing flows, and support for BTC/ETH stablecoin transfers.

components.name: React Native mobile client
components.description: Biometric unlock, transaction history, and push notifications for pending signatures.

components.name: Travel rule compliance module
components.description: IVMS101 payload exchange with counterparty VASPs and sanctions screening integration.

components.name: Transaction audit and reporting
components.description: Immutable audit log, regulatory export formats, and admin investigation tools.
